summary: Vale S.A. filed a Form 6-K announcing the payment of remuneration interest on its 11th issuance unsecured non-convertible debentures, totaling BRL 201,021,910.48, payable on May 15, 2026 to holders as of May 14, 2026. This is a routine interest payment on outstanding debt, not a special situation such as a restructuring or capital return event. No merger, acquisition, tender offer, spin-off, or strategic change is involved. The filing is a standard periodic report of a foreign private issuer. There are no actionable deal terms, and no risk-arb angle or structural event to monitor.
